rationale: Rear-end collision at red light caused total vehicle damage and injury to the policyholder; clear motor vehicle damage and injury scenario.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 yesterday at 8:15am when struck by another vehicle traveling approximately 35 mph without braking. The vehicle is totaled with severe trunk and frame damage. The policyholder has sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Third-party insurance information is documented in the police report.

case_facts.description: rear-ended at red light; other driver ~35 mph, no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; trunk crushed into back seat
